newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Assembly OKs bill capping college fees.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Assembly OKs bill capping college fees.

text.p: California's Assembly approved a bill that would prohibit student fee increases at public colleges and universities until 2000, lawmakers said Tuesday.
The Assembly voted 44-to-20 in favor of the measure, which now advances to the state Senate for review in June.
If enacted, College Affordability Act of 1997 would freeze student fees at University of California, California State University and California Community College System until 2000.
The measure, by Assemblywoman Denise Moreno Ducheny, a Democrat, would also limit student fee increases after 2000 to no more than the rise in personal income from the prior year.
